response.sql: WITH race_averages AS (SELECT c.country, r.raceId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId), country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(ra.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(ra.avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country FROM circuits) AS c LEFT JOIN race_averages AS ra ON ra.country IS c.country GROUP BY c.country) SELECT country, avg_points, avg_wins, avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_vs_country_mean FROM country_averages
